title: BLS LAUS not seasonally adjusted 2025 state annual-average unemployment rate
limitations: BLS rates are estimated from statistical and administrative inputs; not a headcount from an unemployment benefits register.
Annual-average period M13 of unadjusted LAUS series; these are not seasonally adjusted monthly rates.
Source files are periodically revised, including historical years. Each distinct set of source fingerprints creates a new release.
Puerto Rico is included only when it is present in the verified official source and metadata, never imputed.
notes: Archiving compressed exact publisher bytes is intended for reproducibility. Review third-party material and redistribution before merge.
